Sahil Yadav
Backend Java Engineer | Hyderabad, Telangana
sahil.yadav67@example.com | +91 9277852911

Resourceful Java developer with hands-on experience delivering backend services and streaming solutions for payment and enterprise platforms. Strong focus on reliable, testable microservices, event-driven design, and improving deployment velocity through containerization and CI practices. Seeking to contribute to scalable systems and observability improvements; available with a 30 days notice period.

Experience
Razorpay — Nov 2025 - Present
Java Developer
- Implemented Spring Boot microservices for payment reconciliation workflows, designing idempotent endpoints that reduced duplicate processing by 42% and improved end-to-end latency by 18% using async processing.
- Built Kafka-based event pipelines to stream transaction and settlement events across services; tuned consumer groups and partitioning to achieve 99.95% message delivery SLA and reduced consumer lag by 65%.
- Led integration of SpringBoot health checks and metrics, enabling faster incident detection and reducing mean time to recovery (MTTR) by 35%.
- Used Git and Confluence to document APIs and runbooks; collaborated in code reviews and maintained CI pipelines for automated builds and deployments.

Trellis Systems — May 2024 - Oct 2025
Java Developer
- Developed containerized Java services (SpringBoot) deployed with Docker, improving environment parity and cutting onboarding time for new developers by 50%.
- Implemented Kafka producers and consumers for real-time data synchronization between modules, processing ~150k events/day with monitoring and backpressure controls.
- Contributed core business logic in Java to an order-processing platform, optimizing database interactions and reducing average request time by 27%.
- Maintained Git-based workflow and authored Confluence design docs for feature rollouts and deployment procedures.

Projects
- Real-time Event Monitor: Small side project that consumes Kafka topics to aggregate and visualize event rates and consumer lag; deployed locally in Docker and integrated simple alert thresholds.
- Service Health Dashboard: SpringBoot app exposing consolidated health endpoints and Prometheus metrics to track microservice readiness and response time trends.

Languages: Java
Stack: SpringBoot, Kafka, Docker
